reader_summary.headline: "Incremental change may be good theory.
reader_summary.overview: "Incremental change may be good theory. So shares Adrian Cockcroft. So how did they -- and how can other companies -- make such big, bet-the-company kind of moves, without getting mired in fanatical internal debates? Does organizational structure need to change, especially if moving from a more product-, than project-based, approach?

key_points.text: And finally, what happens to the role of CIOs; what can/should they do?
